findings.summary: For self-employed users before 6 years, no after-tax amount is given, yet 25,725 is shown and looks like the answer. This could lead to a wrong decision.
The opening text says people at retirement age need only 3 years, but the calculator never asks for age. Results could mislead those users.
In the year-8 breakdown, a row of six numbers appears above its labels, which are further down. Confusing but recoverable.
The fields jump around when switching to self-employed. This is a layout annoyance, not a toggle that does nothing.
Terms below the result, such as index track, securities account and tax refund, are not explained. Secondary content.
Grey text on a dark background is harder to read. A matter of taste and readability, not a blocker.
